description: Single entry point for cloning apps and websites in Claude Code or Codex. Picks the mode (product, faithful, study) and orchestrates the whole Replica pipeline with eleven specialist subagents (recon, architect, design, entrepreneur, build, backend, test, diff, brand, launch, deploy): runs independent phases in parallel, loops build, test and diff until the clone is shippable, and stops for the user only at scope and before going live. Use when the user says "clone this app end to end", "run the whole replica", "replica crew", "build my own version of X from start to finish", "use the 11 agents", "clone this website", or gives an app or site URL and wants it rebuilt instead of one step.
